privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Learn how we collect, use, and protect personal information on our platform.
privacy.sec1Desc: We collect personal information necessary to operate and improve our service:
privacy.sec1Item1: Account data: Full name, email address, and encrypted password.
privacy.sec1Item2: Usage data: IP address, browser type, and login audit logs.
privacy.sec1Item3: Preferences: Language, timezone, and regional settings.
privacy.sec2Desc: We use your personal information exclusively to:
privacy.sec2Item1: Provide, authenticate, and maintain active services.
privacy.sec2Item2: Notify you about important changes or security updates.
privacy.sec2Item3: Prevent fraud, abuse, or security breaches.
privacy.sec3Desc: We implement industry-grade security standards. Passwords are stored using secure hashing algorithms (bcrypt) and communications use TLS/SSL (HTTPS).
privacy.sec4Desc: We use strictly necessary HTTP session cookies to keep your account authenticated and protect navigation against CSRF and XSS attacks.
privacy.sec5Desc: You have the right to access, rectify, cancel, or object to the processing of your personal data. You can request complete account deletion at any time.
privacy.contactDesc: To exercise your privacy rights or ask questions about your data, contact us at
